Subject: We missed you — short recap from today’s demo and quick rebook request

Hi David —

We ran the 30-minute session on your side today and noticed you weren’t able to join. Totally understand priorities shift — hope everything is ok. Quick recap below so you have the highlights without digging into the recording: 

1) Demo highlights (TL;DR)
- Latency: single-digit tail latency on common prompt profiles; we showed 95th pct numbers for the 8B quantized variant.
- Cost controls: per-route batching and caching reduced per-token cost ~30% in the demo scenario.
- Security: private deployment options + KMS integration and audit logs were summarized.

2) Suggested next step
- Reserved 15-minute exec wrap with CISO to align on security questions and risk/controls. We keep this tight and non-technical.

Can we rebook 15 minutes next week? Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 16 — 10:00–10:15
- Wed Jun 17 — 14:30–14:45
- Thu Jun 18 — 09:00–09:15

If those don’t work, share a few times that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a one-pager aimed at execs to help with pre-read. Recording and full deck available if you want them.

Recording link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xYzDemoRecording

Thanks — I’ll keep the slot flexible and can include Marcus if you prefer the AE presence for next steps.

Best,
